title: Trace spectra of simplices in large sets
summary: Given an ordered tuple $\mathbf v=(v_0,\ldots,v_d)$ of vectors in $\mathbb{R}^d$, let $A_{\mathbf v}=[\,v_1-v_0\ \cdots\ v_d-v_0\,]$ be its edge matrix. We prove that, in every finite colouring of $\mathbb{R}^d$, one colour class realizes every prescribed value of the higher characteristic coefficients \[ (c_2(A_{\mathbf v}),\ldots,c_d(A_{\mathbf v})). \] This extends Graham's theorem on volumes, which corresponds to the last coefficient $c_d(A_{\mathbf v})=\det(A_{\mathbf v})$.
